composition_subtypes.role: sort array a in ascending order
compute min penalty for all k via recurrence dp[i]=sum_prefix+dp[i-m]

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort a ascending, then 1D DP accumulates prefix sums and adds dp[i-m] to compute min total penalty for each k efficiently.
payload.rationale: Sorting puts elements in order required for DP recurrence; DP uses batch structure (m per day) to shift penalties correctly.
